narrative.overview:
The site is a night sky that teaches. A live, photoreal Moon (NASA LRO colour map, Lommel-Seeliger shading, earthshine on the dark limb, a slow libration wobble) is the centre of every screen. At the top of the page it plays the whole month as a time-lapse, about 24 seconds a cycle; once the visitor scrolls, the scroll takes over and each chapter holds one of the eight phases, so reading the page is the lesson the game teaches. Nova, the game's astronaut, floats in front of the Moon as a 3D render from the game, and his helmet is the brand mark beside the wordmark. Everything else steps back: deep indigo ground, hairline panels, real game screenshots in swipeable reels, and the game's own rounded Nunito set heavy for display.

The palette is the game's: night-sky indigo, moonlight gold, Nova's cyan. Gold is light, so it fills only the control the page wants pressed and marks the active phase; elsewhere it appears as a thin line (focus, hover underlines, the reel's progress bar). Cyan is the instrument colour and appears only in the phase readout. The mood is calm, clear and a little playful: a parent should feel reassured by plain facts; a ten-year-old should still feel the sky. Copy is cut to short lines: one sentence under each heading, captions of two to four words.

Density is low. Chapters are tall, single-column on the right, with generous vertical air between them; the left column holds the Moon pinned at a steady size. On phones the Moon becomes a slim pinned strip at the top of the screen so the month keeps turning while the content scrolls, and Nova moves down to the closing chapter.
keyCharacteristics: One dark indigo ground with a single faint cyan radial; no section background changes.
The live Moon is the hero; the pictures are the Moon, Nova renders from the game, and real screenshots.
Gold fills are rationed to the primary action and the active phase; gold lines mark focus and hover.
Hairline borders and tonal surfaces carry structure; shadows are reserved for things that float.
Nunito at 700-900 for every heading, label and control; Nunito Text 400/600 for reading.
Motion follows the Moon: a strong ease-out for responses, an ease-in-out for things drifting on their own, and nothing moves under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Moonlight Rule
rules.body: Gold is light, not decoration. A gold fill appears on the primary action and the active phase; gold lines appear on focus, hover underlines and the reel's progress. If a screen has two gold fills competing, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Instrument Rule
rules.body: Cyan belongs to the Moon readout. It never colours a button, link, heading or border.

rules.name: The Scoped Signal Rule
rules.body: Rose exists only inside reviews and green only for reassurance (safety facts, success). Neither becomes a general accent.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Nunito heavy for anything you scan or press; Nunito Text for anything you read. Never set a paragraph in 800, never set a button in 400.

rules.name: The Real Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every version, size, count, date, slide number and day number uses tabular numerals so live values never shift the layout.

rules.name: The Short Line Rule
rules.body: One sentence under a heading, two to four words under a screenshot. If a line needs a comma to keep going, cut it.

rules.name: The Pinned Sky Rule
rules.body: The Moon never scrolls away. On every width some form of it stays pinned and keeps reporting the day and phase.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Panels are flat and outlined. A shadow means the object floats over the sky (a screenshot, the main action, Nova), never that a card is important.

dos: **Do** keep the page on one indigo ground (#090b1f) and build hierarchy with Deep Orbit and High Orbit surfaces plus 1px hairlines.
**Do** spend gold fills only on the primary action and the active phase; use gold lines for focus, hover underlines and progress.
**Do** keep cyan inside the Moon readout.
**Do** set headings, buttons and labels in Nunito 700-900 and reading text in Nunito Text 400/600.
**Do** make every text control a pill (50px buttons, 40px choice pills) and every icon-only control a circle, with a visible 2px gold focus outline.
**Do** use tabular numerals for every version, size, date, count, slide number and day.
**Do** show the real game: native-aspect screenshots in a reel, 14px corners, a hairline edge, the Float shadow, no device chrome.
**Do** keep copy to one short sentence per heading and two to four words per caption.

**Do** ease responses with cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) and on-screen drift with cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1); press to 0.97 over 160ms; turn every entrance, reveal, drift and swap off under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: **Don't** introduce a light theme or alternate section backgrounds; the sky is continuous.
**Don't** use rose or green outside reviews and reassurance.
**Don't** add illustrations, stock imagery or device mockups; the pictures are the Moon, Nova renders from the game and real screenshots.
**Don't** put shadows on panels or cards to signal importance.
**Don't** invent ratings, counts or testimonials to fill an empty state; empty states say so plainly.
**Don't** give hover effects to touch devices; hover rules sit behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
